items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: when I was with Red Allen, they had, had Red Allen, they had John Casmy, myself, old man Glenny, and a fella by the name of Lucci

ctx.x: Yeah, in Red Allen, in Sonny Allen's band.
Oh, well, at the time when they, when I was with Red Allen, they had, had Red Allen, they had John Casmy, myself, old man Glenny, and a fella by the name of Lucci used to play trombone. What?
Lucci. You know, Tom Albert's son, Albert Jackson, Pinky's father? Yeah, he had a son play trombone too.

items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: They had them two Cadmys boys.

ctx.x: Well, Tats was there, down there. They had... They had them two Cadmys boys.
